Addis Eats — Next-Gen Food Ordering & TeleBirr Gateway
Full-stack online food ordering platform with server/client component boundaries, dynamic cart state, and TeleBirr
checkout with Ethiopian phone validation, localized sub-city delivery fee calculations, and 30-min delay escalation.
Addis Eats — Modular React Single-Page Application
Single-page application featuring Zustand with persist middleware for reliable local storage cart rehydration,
real-time stock decrements, frosted out-of-stock overlay for exhausted meals, and visual sales telemetry via Recharts.
Addis Eats — Vanilla Web App & Admin Session Guard
Zero-dependency food ordering and administrative operations dashboard developed from the ground up using pure
HTML5, CSS3, and ECMAScript (ES6+) with SessionStorage auth guards and verified regression redirects.
